acceptance: Harden direct Jaeger/OTLP HTTP export with a finite internal timeout and unsuccessful-response isolation without changing the default file backend or accepted configuration fields.

A local in-process HTTP stub receives the expected POST path, content type, existing OTLP envelope, and opaque-session-ID-only payload; invalid references and path/content sentinels do not escape the projection.

Refused/unavailable endpoints, delayed responses exceeding the timeout, and non-2xx responses resolve without propagating telemetry failure; no retry, buffering, duplicate export, external service, collector, or query client is introduced.

Existing file, retention, privacy, session-reference, lifecycle, evidence-tool, task-record, JSON, content/navigation, build, whitespace, and diff checks pass; no launcher, task, process, host, target, or evidence-query ownership changes.
